_note: API shape for Raya Voice AI (LitWiz Labs). Configured from the Raya REST docs. No secrets here — base URL + token live in raya/.env. '{id}' is replaced with a target's raya_agent_id (the agent uuid). Auth is 'X-API-Key: <token>' (no scheme prefix). Update is a PATCH with a PARTIAL body: only prompt_field is sent, all other agent settings are untouched. Fields ending in *_field / *_path accept a dotted JSON path; '' = response root.
